items.html: And behold, the most praiseworthy discernment among them was sorted and appointed, and it became the world of Atzilut; and from the discernment inferior to the first was sorted and made the world of Beriah; and from the more inferior was made the world of Yetzirah; and from the most inferior was made the world of Assiyah. And the most inferior of all are the dregs, called the filth of the sediment of the gold [Zohama de-Tocha de-Dahava], which have no use to be sorted, since they are exceedingly harsh judgments, until they are called actual Klipot. And these are the Klipot mentioned everywhere in the book of the Zohar.
